title: Derive shadow measurements from boundary corners and calibration
user_business_goal: Add the missing shadow-only measurement bridge from sanitized detected boundary/corners plus calibration scale into length, width, and diagonal measurement evidence, then feed the existing product tolerance and Phase 1/2 decision logic.
out_of_scope: raw media, raw datasets, customer/factory data, notebooks, model weights, TensorRT engines, model binaries, or model execution
live camera capture, camera SDK loading, camera credentials, GPU/hardware validation, or hardware readiness approval
production deploy/release, secrets, tokens, provider credentials, destructive migrations, production data migration, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary change
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject behavior
acceptance_criteria: Geometry derives 3 length points, 3 width points, and 2 diagonals from four sanitized boundary corners.
Derivation uses explicit calibration.geometry.inch_per_pixel evidence and fails closed when calibration scale is missing or invalid.
Derived measurement payload remains geometry.measurement_set.v1, production_authority=false, and carries boundary/calibration source evidence.
Replay frames can provide boundary corners instead of precomputed measurements and produce the same measurement contract for HMI/replay output.
Existing product tolerance logic consumes derived measurements without changing production authority.
Diagonal deviation derives from the two calibrated diagonals and remains subject to existing Phase 2 logic.
Docs/tests clarify this is shadow-only and does not resolve QC/SOP tolerance approval, product spec approval, camera hardware approval, or production release approval.
required_checks: python3 -m unittest tests.flange_qc_v2.test_calibration tests.flange_qc_v2.test_geometry tests.flange_qc_v2.test_replay tests.flange_qc_v2.test_decision_engine tests.flange_qc_v2.test_hmi_stream -v
HTTP preview smoke for /inspection/replay when local preview is available

retrieved_decisions: Current app evaluates provided length/width/diagonal measurements and product tolerance logic is shadow-only.
Production authority remains false; product spec and QC/SOP approval are human-gated.
Open SOP questions remain unresolved, so this task must use bootstrap shadow evidence only.
retrieved_lessons: Readiness labels and geometry evidence must distinguish shadow measurement logic from production approval.
Replay/HMI should consume sanitized metadata and measurements, not raw media.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: Open SOP/QC approval questions remain, so this task does not approve product tolerance interpretation or production measurement method.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-048 PR to restore replay to precomputed measurements only. Existing product tolerance, decision engine, HMI, detector bridge, and product CI behavior remain valid.
